description: Recursos protegidos — nunca acessíveis por agentes, mesmo em leitura (OAGE §19, §41).
denyWritePatternsNote: Governance/audit/plugin internals are the Governance Kernel itself — INSTRUCTIONS.md's absolute prohibitions already say an agent must never modify its own permissions or the kernel, but nothing technically enforced that until this list included these paths.
